statements.impact_statement: The advisory concerns only golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp and its subpackages. None is in the runtime dependency closure of the Infra server/connector/CLI binary. CI verifies this for all six supported OS/architecture combinations and runs govulncheck -scan=package. x/crypto is retained for maintained cryptography packages. This statement is scoped to x/crypto v0.58.0 and must be reviewed after a version change.
